 package bottlesong
 
-import "fmt"
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"unicode"
+)
 
+// capitalize uppercases only the first rune of s.
+func capitalize(s string) string {
+	if s == "" {
+		return s
+	}
+	r := []rune(s)
+	r[0] = unicode.ToUpper(r[0])
+	return string(r)
+}
